# MantineHub shadcn Theme

Unmodified copy of the shadcn theme from
[MantineHub](https://github.com/RubixCube-Innovations/mantine-theme-builder)
at commit `111cdb99b5ba042fd213272dba8059b48c372af5`, under its MIT licence
(`LICENSE`). App-specific overrides live in [`ui/theme.ts`](../../theme.ts);
replace these files from upstream rather than editing them.
